preregistration.summary: Recomputed before opening runs/. Rents 84.900/mes x 12 = 1.018.800. Market 16.430.000 (9 locados 14.430.000), declared 4.720.000 (9 locados 4.220.000). ITBI: holding de locacao = atividade preponderante (CTN 37), imunidade afastada; 3% x 16.430.000 = 492.900 (all 11) or 432.900 (9 locados). PJ presumido: base 326.016; IRPJ 48.902,40 + adicional 8.601,60 + CSLL 29.341,44 + PIS/COFINS 37.186,20 = 124.031,64 (12,17%); IRRF 10% on full distribution (1.018.800 - 124.031,64 = 894.768,36) = 89.476,84; total 213.508,48 (20,96%). Excess-only reading of 'acima de R$ 50 mil/mes' would give 29.476,84 / 153.508,48; netting the released 8% admin fee from distributable profit gives 813.264,36 -> 81.326,44 (full) or 21.326,44 (excess) -> 205.358,08 or 145.358,08. GCAP evitado (16.430.000 - 4.720.000) x 15% = 1.756.500. ITCMD 4% x 4.720.000 = 188.800 (palestra) vs 4% x 16.430.000 = 657.200 (market); 2/3-1/3 with usufruto. Legitima 50%; Marcos cannot be excluded (CC 1.845/1.846, 549, 544, 1.848); his individual floor = 1/6 of acervo (18.530.000/6 = 3.088.333). Agree with key on all qualitative items; two quantitative oracle items carry fixture tension (see fixture_issues).

cross_run_observations: All five runs caught traps 1-5 unprompted and returned the correct qualitative oracle answers (itbi.devido true, marcos_pode_ser_excluido false, five verdicts). Four runs (A-D) excluded Campos/Cotia and reported 4.220.000; only E kept all 11 and thereby matched the literal key 4.720.000 - the oracle/trap-6 conflict in the manifest makes that item discriminate in the wrong direction unless both values are accepted, as pre-registered here. The pj_presumido.total key (213.508,48) was hit by no run: every run netted the released 8% fee from distributable profit, and B/C/D/E read the R$ 50k threshold as excess-only (145.358,08); A applied 10% to the whole distribution (205.358,08). All four alternative models were explicitly flagged as library-ambiguous; the item was treated as diagnostic. Only C raised trust concerns: false attribution of CC 1.814/1.829 to the library and a Guarulhos 11%/galpao-isencao claim attributed to the palestra that the document never makes, plus an empty review turn. B, D and E performed substantive self-reviews (B: flags; D: two arithmetic corrections; E: citation cleanup). Legal depth varied on the succession design: C applied the imputation rule correctly (donations impute first to the donatees' legitimas); D and E conservatively capped donations at the disponivel; B proposed paying Marcos his 1/6 in quotas now; A gave an indicative minimum without a structure.
